name: TREC CAR (Complex Answer Retrieval)
description:
Retrieving paragraphs to populate a Wikipedia article is a challenging task.
The new TREC Complex Answer Retrieval (TREC CAR) track introduces a
comprehensive dataset that targets this retrieval scenario. We present early
results from a variety of approaches -- from standard information retrieval
methods (e.g., tf-idf) to complex systems that using query expansion using
knowledge bases and deep neural networks. The goal is to offer future
participants of this track an overview of some promising approaches to tackle
this problem.
evaluation_method: Standard IR ranking metrics (MAP, MRR, nDCG@k)
general_score_metric: nDCG@k (commonly reported), MAP and MRR also used
typical_sota_score: varies by task and evaluation cut; typical nDCG/MAP ranges roughly 0.2–0.6 depending on setup and reranking
reputation: Widely used and well-cited IR benchmark for complex passage retrieval from Wikipedia; common in academic retrieval research and system evaluation.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark originally (IR focus); large-scale and multi-stage retrieval setups common; moderate contamination risk from overlap with models' training corpora (Wikipedia); evaluation sensitive to pooling and relevance judgments.
